NEAR MISS INCIDENTS

As the workload requirements exceed the remaining resources, the work will be exited and not subject to the subcontracting provisions of GM-UAW National Agreement.

In the event the local parties are unable to reach an agreement on the identification of non-strategic work and /or the process for reassigning skilled trade employees, either party may refer the matter to the GM-UAW Skilled Trades and Apprentice Committee as directed in the skilled trades /indirect labor audit for resolution.
